channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Carlos Arroyo | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Carlos Arroyo from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: LeBron James on Carlos Arroyo
item.description:
“He’s been here from Day 1, and he put a lot of hard work into it. Being our starting point guard early in the season, just staying with a positive attitude when that job was taken away from him. So much respect to Carlos.”

LeBron James on Carlos Arroyo, Mar 1, 2011. Source: Palm Beach Post.

item.title: Pat Riley on Carlos Arroyo
item.description:
The Miami HEAT announced today that they have requested waivers on guard Carlos Arroyo.

“This was a very difficult decision to make because Carlos has done a great job for this team and this organization,”

Pat Riley on Carlos Arroyo, Mar 1, 2011. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Carlos Arroyo
item.description:
“It wasn't anything that Carlos was doing wrong. He was doing everything that I asked him to do. I think this is what's best for the team right now.”

Erik Spoelstra on Carlos Arroyo, Jan 24, 2011. Source: ESPN.com.
